name: wal-commit-completeness
targetProperty: During commit, every page in the dirty_pages bitmap is written to a WAL frame before the commit is finalized

S0.label: S0
S0.content: Every page in dirty_pages bitmap must have a corresponding WAL frame written before commit completes
S0.formal: ∀ page_id ∈ dirty_pages at commit start: ∃ frame in prepared_frames where frame.page_id == page_id

G1.label: G1
G1.content: ScanAndIssueReads iterates ALL pages in dirty_pages bitmap

G2.label: G2
G2.content: PrepareFrames processes ALL page_sources into collected_pages

G3.label: G3
G3.content: prepare_collected_frames converts ALL collected_pages to WAL frames
G3.formal: sum of prepared_frames[i].metadata.len() == total pages processed

G4.label: G4
G4.content: WaitWrites ensures ALL prepared frames are durably written before WalCommitDone
G4.formal: all write completions succeed before state advances to WalCommitDone

G5.label: G5
G5.content: dirty_pages is only cleared AFTER all frames are committed
G5.formal: dirty_pages.clear() happens in WalCommitDone state, after commit_prepared_frames

R1.label: R1
R1.content: In ScanAndIssueReads state (lines 3529-3560), the code iterates over dirty_pages.iter() with a for loop. For EACH page_id in the bitmap, it pushes exactly one PageSource (either Cached or Evicted) to commit_info.page_sources. The loop is unconditional - no early breaks, continues, or filters. The initialize() call at line 3536 reserves space for dirty_pages.len() entries. Therefore |page_sources| == |dirty_pages| at the end of this state.

R2.label: R2
R2.content: In PrepareFrames state (lines 3590-3643), there's an inner loop that iterates while cursor < page_sources.len(). Each iteration: (1) retrieves page from page_sources[cursor], (2) increments page_source_cursor (line 3613), (3) pushes page to collected_pages (line 3614). The loop only breaks when cursor >= page_sources.len() (line 3597-3598). There are no early exits within the loop. Therefore all page_sources entries are processed into collected_pages.

R3.label: R3
R3.content: prepare_collected_frames (lines 3739-3762) is called when collected_pages reaches IOV_MAX or is_last==true (line 3616). It takes ALL pages via std::mem::take (line 3748), then calls wal.prepare_frames(&pages, ...) which creates exactly one PreparedFrames entry per page (line 1984 loop: for (idx, page) in pages.iter().enumerate()). Each page produces one entry in metadata vec (line 2019). The result is pushed to prepared_frames (line 3760). The batching ensures no pages are lost between collected_pages and prepared_frames.

R4.label: R4
R4.content: The state machine has explicit ordering: PrepareFrames → WaitWrites → WaitSync → WalCommitDone. In WaitWrites (lines 3644-3685): (1) waits until ALL completions.iter().all(|c| c.finished()) (line 3650), (2) checks for ANY failed completion (line 3655-3660), (3) returns error if any failed (line 3668), (4) only advances to WaitSync/WalCommitDone if all writes succeeded. In WaitSync (lines 3693-3717): waits for fsync, errors if failed. Therefore WalCommitDone is only reached after ALL writes are durable.

R5.label: R5
R5.content: In WalCommitDone state (lines 3719-3732), the execution order is: (1) wal.commit_prepared_frames() - updates WAL index (line 3722), (2) wal.finalize_committed_pages() - marks pages clean (line 3723), (3) wal.finish_append_frames_commit() - finalizes WAL state (line 3724), (4) ONLY THEN dirty_pages.write().clear() (line 3725). The clear happens at the END of successful commit, not before. If any earlier state fails and returns Err, dirty_pages is NOT cleared.

A1.label: A1
A1.content: Dirty pages cannot be evicted from cache. In page_cache.rs:605-611, evictable() returns false for dirty pages: (!page.is_dirty() || page.is_spilled()). During commit, all pages in dirty_pages are by definition dirty. Therefore, Cached pages in page_sources cannot be evicted between ScanAndIssueReads and PrepareFrames. The expect() at line 3609 serves as a defensive check but should never trigger.
